topbarTitle: Batch Manager (browse / filter / delete / export / transfer / rename)

side.tip: Click a notebook to browse its docs (lazy tree); filters above are SQL-based and can span notebooks

table.title: Title
table.emptyHint: Click a notebook on the left to browse, or use the filters above to query

select.tipNone: Check documents in the table to enable the batch actions below

delete.confirmBody: You are about to delete {n} documents
delete.withChildren: including about {c} sub-documents that will be deleted together
delete.maybeChildren: Filtered results may contain sub-documents, they will be deleted with their parents
delete.trashTip: Documents will be moved to trash (Doc tree → More → Trash, recoverable)
delete.permanentTip: DANGER: they will be physically removed from trash immediately and CANNOT be recovered!
delete.permanentFailed: moved to trash, but permanent purge failed (clean up manually in trash)

exportDlg.title: Batch export
exportDlg.individual: Save one by one (a zip per doc)
exportDlg.assetsTip: Merged + assets is packaged by the kernel in one shot (recommended); without assets, pure Markdown files are exported

move.title: Batch transfer
move.searchPh: Search target parent doc by title keyword
move.searchTip: Type a keyword and press Enter, then click a result to set it as the target parent doc
move.target: Target parent doc (optional, notebook root by default)
move.invalidChild: target is a sub-document of it
move.invalidHint: {n} document(s) whose target is itself or its own sub-document will be skipped
move.invalidAll: None of the selected documents can be transferred to this target

rename.title: Batch rename
rename.badName: Result title is empty or contains illegal chars like /
rename.needFind: Please fill in the find text

settings.title: Plugin settings
settings.directDeleteTip: Only affects the default state of the checkbox in the delete confirmation dialog
settings.concurrencyTip: 1~3; delete always runs serially for safety

msg.canceled: Operation canceled, see report for finished part
